newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Boxing legend Ali on charity visit to Indonesia.
newsitem.headline: Boxing legend Ali on charity visit to Indonesia.

text.p: Boxing legend Muhammad Ali flew into Indonesia on Sunday, trading mock punches with airport guards and tourists and demonstrating his trademark two-step shuffle as he arrived on a charity visit.
The 54-year old Ali walked haltingly through the immigration gate but then sparred playfully with security guards and onlookers.
Ali has suffered for more than a decade from Parkinson's Syndrome, an illness of the central nervous system, and he rarely speaks in public.
Ali is in Indonesia to donate 100,000 meals to a Jakarta hospital from his Muhammad Ali Foundation in partnership with Vitapro Foods Inc of Canada, which produces a dehydrated food product.
It was Ali's second visit to Indonesia, the world's most populous Islamic state, after a humanitarian mission in 1991.
